change.after: "drop all capabilities and run as non-root user"

consequence.statement: Clustermesh-apiserver pods will run with restricted security contexts (dropped capabilities, non-root user) by default if the operator does not explicitly override these values.

assertion.statement: The clustermesh-apiserver's Helm chart values for `podSecurityContext` and `securityContext` now default to dropping all capabilities and running as a non-root user.
